title: Cross-team Oncall Routing & KPI Rotations — Activation Playbook
summary: Compact operational playbook to coordinate cross-team oncall routing, KPI rotation ownership, and surge response during phased activations. Designed to sit alongside the primary launch runbook and provide a light-weight, repeatable routing + metric ownership cadence for product ops, SRE, serving-runtime, and support.
content:
Purpose:
This doc defines a single-page operational layer that sits between the master launch runbook and team-specific incident processes. It focuses on two hard problems we repeatedly hit during activations: (1) who owns immediate KPI monitoring at each traffic gate, and (2) how oncall routing changes as we scale traffic and degrade gracefully. Goal is to reduce cognitive load and handoffs in the first 6 hours of an activation and standardize KPI handoffs across teams.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to staged activations (beta -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%).
- Teams in scope: product-ops (owner), eng-sre, serving-runtime, infra, console-and-tooling, customer-success.
- Assumes existing primary incident channel and SLOs defined in prod runbook. This is the overlay for metric ownership and routing during traffic shifts.

Key concepts (short):
- Primary Gatekeeper: product-ops rep who coordinates traffic shift and triggers routing changes.
- KPI Steward: rotating owner responsible for watching a named metric tile during a traffic gate window and escalating if thresholds cross.
- Routing Shift: change in oncall routing (e.g., add infra oncall to immediate page, move chat triage to dedicated channel).
- Soft-fallback: pre-approved downgraded model/variant to route traffic to if primary model latency/cost crosses defined threshold.

Activation checklist (compact):
1) T-48h: Declare AP (Activation Plan) and assign Primary Gatekeeper + 2 backup stewards.
2) T-24h: Publish gate windows and KPI tiles (links to dashboards) into activation channel.
3) T-2h: Run routing smoke test (simulate a page to each oncall rotation target).
4) T+0 (first gate): Execute traffic shift step; product-ops posts routing map + KPI steward names.
5) T+gate (continuous): Every 30m scorecard update from KPI stewards for first 6h.
6) T+24h: Post-activation handoff note and update rotation schedule for next 7 days.

KPI rotation matrix (example, use in dashboard):
- Latency P50/P95: KPI Steward = eng-sre shift lead (first 6h). Thresholds: P95 > 600ms -> page eng-sre; P95 > 1200ms -> hold traffic, fallback.
- Error rate (5m): KPI Steward = serving-runtime oncall. Thresholds: > 1% -> page serving-runtime; > 3% -> stop rollout.
- Cost per 1k tokens: KPI Steward = product-ops finance liaison. Thresholds: 2x baseline -> investigate; 3x baseline -> throttle non-essential models.
- End-user regressions (QA signal): KPI Steward = customer-success triage. Thresholds: 5 escalations in 30m -> slow traffic and enable rollback gating.

Routing rules (text):
- Normal -> Gate 1: Default oncall routing stays in primary channel. Only product-ops and KPI stewards actively post updates.
- Elevated -> Gate 2 or if any threshold crossed: Add infra and serving-runtime oncall to primary page rotation (immediate paging), and create a temporary #activation-escalation Slack channel.
- Critical -> Stop traffic shift, remove auto-scaling bursts, fall back to pre-approved smaller model variant and open postmortem bridge.

Escalation flow (stepwise):
1) KPI steward observes threshold -> posts update and triggers page to their oncall.
2) If steward cannot mitigate within 10 minutes, Primary Gatekeeper pages cross-team incident lead.
3) If cross-team lead cannot remediate within 20 minutes, escalate to Director oncall and consider traffic rollback.

Rotation schedule template (example):
- 00:00-06:00 UTC: KPI stewards = LIAM (eng-sre), RAVI (serving-runtime), CARLA (support).
- 06:00-14:00 UTC: KPI stewards = PRIYA (product-ops), MORGAN (product-ops backup), JESSICA (finance).
- 14:00-22:00 UTC: KPI stewards = RAVI (serving-runtime), LIAM (infra backup), CARLA (support).
Notes: product-ops owns a 7-day rotation after the activation window to monitor lingering regressions.

Simulation scenarios (run during T-24h rehearsal):
Scenario A — Latency spike: Inject artificial latency on a canary instance and observe routing behaviour. Verify eng-sre pages and that product-ops pauses traffic.
Scenario B — Cost shock: Simulate a sudden surge of long-sequence requests to test cost alerting -> product-ops throttles non-critical inference pipelines.
Scenario C — User regression: Seed a small sample of queries with known failure patterns; confirm customer-success alerts and rollback gating.

Acceptance & gating criteria (per gate):
- Gate open if: P95 < 400ms, error rate < 0.25%, cost delta < 1.5x baseline, no more than 1 user escalation in last 15m.
- Gate hold if: any single metric in yellow zone (P95 400-600ms, error rate 0.25-1%, cost 1.5-2x). Hold for minimum 15m, execute remedial actions.
- Gate abort if: any metric in red (P95 > 600ms, error rate >1%, cost >2x, >3 user escalations 30m). Abort means revert to previous traffic percentage and open incident bridge.

Communication templates (short):
- Post to channel when shifting traffic: "[GATE 2] shifting from 10% to 25% at 2025-02-03T14:00Z — KPI stewards: Liam (latency), Ravi (errors), Priya (cost). Monitor for 15m."
- Page escalation template: "PAGE: {metric} breached threshold on {tile}. Current value: {value}. Steward: {name}. Action taken: {action}. Next escalate T+{minutes}."
Post-activation artifacts to produce:
- Activation scorecard (CSV) with 1m resolution for first 6h: fields = timestamp, traffic_pct, p50, p95, errors_5m, cost_per_1k, user_escalations_count.
- Short debrief (1 page) capturing decisions and rotation effectiveness.
- Action items list (owners + due dates) for any recurring gaps.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Confirm product-ops finance liaison for cost KPI during activation (needed by T-48h).
- Decide whether to automatically add infra oncall on any P95 > 800ms or require steward confirmation.
- Define retention window for activation scorecards (default: 90 days) and ownership of long-term storage.

Next steps (owner/action):
- Morgan: finalize routing test script and publish into the activation channel (due T-24h).
- Ravi: instrument dashboard tiles to include cost-per-1k token (due T-24h).
- Priya: draft oncall rotation calendar for the quarter and post to team calendar (due in 3 days).

Appendix A — quick checklist (one-liner):
- Assign gatekeeper, assign KPI stewards, verify dashboards, run routing smoke, confirm fallback model, execute gate windows, 30m cadence updates, debrief + 7-day monitoring.

Revision log:
- 2025-01-15: Drafted by Morgan Li.
- 2025-01-22: Added escalation timings and simulation scenarios (Ravi).
- 2025-02-03: Clarified acceptance thresholds and added cost steward (Priya).
objectives: Reduce cross-team paging during first 6h of activation
Standardize KPI ownership at each gate
Enable predictable routing changes tied to metric thresholds
Provide small-footprint simulation checklist to rehearse routing and stewarding

Add cost-per-1k metric to primary dashboard tiles
